name: Sonnet growth at a reasonable price
strategy: GARP: quality growth companies with durable competitive advantages, trading at reasonable multiples relative to their growth rates (as of Jan 2026 knowledge). Mix of large-cap tech compounders, healthcare/industrial growers, and financials benefiting from secular trends, avoiding the most extreme high-multiple hypergrowth names while still capturing above-market earnings growth.

orders.reason: Thesis broken: guidance cuts and Clover deceleration erased the growth leg of GARP; -23% reflects real fundamental deterioration, not just multiple compression.
Up 76.6% in H1, valuation has run far ahead of semicap-cycle growth; taking profit to stay disciplined on the 'reasonable price' half of GARP.
Cyclical energy re-rate (+30%) isn't a durable-growth compounder; rotating proceeds into higher-quality secular growers.
Payments network moat, consistent double-digit EPS growth, reasonable multiple relative to growth vs peers — classic GARP replacement for FISV.
Durable cloud/AI compounder with broad moat; entering after a period of digestion offers better growth-adjusted valuation than chasing extended semicap names.
Dominant robotic-surgery franchise with high recurring revenue and strong growth runway, more durable than a single commodity-cycle energy name.

outlook: Expect AI-infrastructure and quality secular growers to keep leading into year-end as rate-cut expectations support multiples, with periodic volatility around cyclicals; positioning tilts toward durable-moat compounders trading at reasonable growth-adjusted multiples rather than the most extended momentum names.
